Surah Al-Balad (90) — The City · 20 ayahs · Meccan

Main teachings:
• Man is encompassed by Allah and His Bounties
• He was from the believers who worked righteous deeds, and advised each other to be patient with the harms of the people, and to be merciful with them.
• Then, along with these beautiful and pure characteristics, he was a believer in his heart, seeking the reward of that from Allah.
• It will be sealed over them and there will be no way for them to avoid it, nor will they have any way out.

Surah Al-Lail (92) — The Night · 21 ayahs · Meccan

Main teachings:
• Proving that Allah rewards those who intend good with success, while whoever intends evil is abandoned, and all of this is in accordance with a preordained decree.
• Hoping to attain the blessing of seeing Him in the final abode in the Gardens of Paradise.
• The recompense in the abode of the Hereafter.
• The righteous, pure, most pious person will be saved from the Fire.
• The actions of the servants that they have performed are also opposites and diverse.

Quran 46:6 — Al-Ahqaf (The Dunes)

وَإِذَا حُشِرَ ٱلنَّاسُ كَانُوا۟ لَهُمْ أَعْدَآءًۭ وَكَانُوا۟ بِعِبَادَتِهِمْ كَٰفِرِينَ

Transliteration: Wa izaa hushiran naasu kaanoo lahum a'daaa'anw wa kaanoo bi'ibaadatihim kaafireen

Translation: And when the people are gathered [that Day], they [who were invoked] will be enemies to them, and they will be deniers of their worship.

Quran 52:30 — At-Tur (The Mount)

أَمْ يَقُولُونَ شَاعِرٌۭ نَّتَرَبَّصُ بِهِۦ رَيْبَ ٱلْمَنُونِ

Transliteration: Am yaqooloona shaa'irun natarabbasu bihee raibal manoon

Translation: Or do they say [of you], "A poet for whom we await a misfortune of time?"

sources.snippet: Quran 52:30. Arabic: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ شَاعِرٌۭ نَّتَرَبَّصُ بِهِۦ رَيْبَ ٱلْمَنُونِ. English: Or do they say [of you], "A poet for whom we await a misfortune of time?". Urdu: کیا کافر کہتے ہیں کہ یہ شاعر ہے (اور) ہم اس کے حق میں زمانے کے حوادث کا انتظار کر رہے ہیں.
